theorems_audited.theorem: Theorem 1: Dirichlet Evidence Variance Upper Bound

theorems_audited.qualification: Explicitly qualified that non-uniform single-class accumulation does not guarantee point variance contraction for all classes.

theorems_audited.theorem: Proposition 2: Lipschitz Continuity of Perception Risk
theorems_audited.formulation: |R_p(x1) - R_p(x2)| <= (w_u L_u + w_d L_d + w_b L_b + w_k L_k) ||x1 - x2||
